##### Project general facts

Riviera 59 is a newly launched residential building that embodies luxury and sophistication, nestled within a cluster of buildings and offering artistically designed studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. Each living space is thoughtfully crafted to provide a harmonious blend of comfort, style, and functionality, with modern finishes and abundant natural light creating an exquisite living experience. The building also boasts expansive retail spaces, providing residents with convenient access to a variety of shopping and dining options right at their doorstep.

The development features premium amenities including an innovative home control system, smart lock access, and panoramic glass elevators that add a touch of modern sophistication. Residents can enjoy the finest in contemporary living with every detail meticulously designed to enhance their daily experience. The integration of retail spaces adds value and convenience to the neighborhood, creating a truly self-contained community.

Each residence features Italian marble flooring, premium wood joinery, and bespoke lighting that create an atmosphere of refined elegance throughout. The kitchens are fully equipped with premium built-in appliances, including refrigerator, oven, microwave, electric hob, and dishwasher with German mechanisms and accessories. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a comfortable and stylish home environment that exemplifies high-end living.


##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in the heart of Meydan within MBR City, an extraordinary community known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. The area offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment across its expansive landscape. The community is renowned for its iconic racecourse, which hosts prestigious events including the Dubai World Cup, creating an aura of excitement and elegance that attracts enthusiasts from around the world.

The neighborhood features expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards that create a serene and refreshing environment for residents to enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, and picnics. The abundance of open spaces provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a strong sense of community and well-being. The area's commitment to a luxurious lifestyle extends to high-end hotels, gourmet restaurants, and upscale shopping destinations all within easy reach.

Sports enthusiasts will find the community a haven for their passion, with state-of-the-art facilities including equestrian centers, tennis courts, and golf courses catering to both professionals and amateurs. The central location offers excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of luxury living, recreational excellence, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.
